description: Electric utility cash-flow skeleton for SIC 4911 retaining 216 supplied US GAAP concepts once. The supplied Duke Energy presentation guides operating, investing and financing presentation; official definitions preserve AFUDC, regulatory, nuclear fuel, trust funding and cash-population scopes. Hierarchy implies no arithmetic.
classification_notes: The 216-concept SIC inventory covers multiple issuers. Duke Energy reference presentation is a broad presentation reference and does not establish that Duke Energy reports every concept.
No unsupported funds-from-operations, free-cash-flow, net debt or gross/net subtotal is manufactured from a reference presentation. Missing facts are not zero.
Total and continuing/discontinued cash-flow scopes are preserved where supplied. Cash, restricted cash and disposal/discontinued populations must match balances, period changes and FX effects.
ProfitLoss includes NCI. All indirect adjustments must use the issuer starting-profit population and reverse only appropriate effects already included in earnings.
AFUDC equity, total earnings additions and capitalization changes overlap. Other-funds AFUDC investing cash has an explicit investing definition and is not the equity AFUDC earnings reversal.

Combined regulatory asset/liability movements can contain other regulatory assets, regulatory liabilities and deferred fuel; expense, credit and balance movements require reconciliation rather than blanket addition.
Nuclear fuel cash purchase/net activity can overlap cash productive-asset purchases. Nuclear fuel amortization is noncash. Unpaid capex, ROU acquisition and debt conversion remain supplementary.

Decommissioning fund flows are investment purchases/sales and can overlap other investment totals. ARO actual settlement is generally operating; total ARO balance movement and unresolved plant-removal cash remain separate.
Gross/net borrowing, maturity, security, seniority, instrument and related-party views overlap. Equity issuance net of costs differs from gross proceeds and financing cost payments.

Equity-method operating return on investment differs from investing return of capital. Earnings net of distributions already contain the matched distributions. Subsidiary control retention differs from deconsolidating divestiture.

Lease expense, ROU amortization, liability movement and paid lease cash are alternative reconciliation parts, not independent adjustments to sum. Similar reconciliation is needed for pension expense, obligation change and contributions.

Shared cautions belong to group classification_note; specific measurement, placement or overlap uncertainty has an individual review_reason. All nodes use aggregation_policy none; signs follow source facts.

metadata_contract.period_type: 214 duration monetary concepts and 2 instant monetary cash-balance concepts, verified against official US GAAP 2026.
metadata_contract.unit_type: All 216 concepts are monetary; currency and scale come from source facts.
metadata_contract.contra: All false: cash-flow earnings adjustments, payments, receipts and supplemental balances do not prescribe automatic sign inversion.

taxonomy_reference.note: Metadata and definitions checked against official 2026 schema and documentation. Historical filings retain their own taxonomy versions and units.

sources.description: 216 unique user-supplied US GAAP concepts for SIC 4911.
Official FASB 2026 schema and documentation retained locally.

children.label: Operating scope views
children.classification_note: Discontinued operating cash is a scope component of total operating cash where reported; no unsupported continuing operating total is manufactured.

children.label: Reported starting profit
children.classification_note: ProfitLoss includes noncontrolling interests. Use the issuer reported starting scope; no absent parent-only income concept is manufactured.

children.label: Depreciation amortization and accretion views
children.classification_note: Combined depreciation/amortization/accretion, DD&A and narrower asset consumption measures overlap. Nuclear-fuel amortization is noncash asset consumption despite the Lease suffix.

children.label: Combined asset consumption views
children.classification_note: Select a reported combined adjustment or reconciled components; no automatic sum across these overlapping aggregates.

concepts.name: us-gaap:DepreciationAmortizationAndAccretionNet
concepts.review_reason: Net depreciation/amortization/accretion includes noncash accretion as well as asset consumption and can contain the standalone DD&A and ARO adjustments.

concepts.name: us-gaap:DepreciationDepletionAndAmortization
concepts.review_reason: Total DD&A can contain depreciation, intangible amortization and nuclear-fuel amortization supplied separately; select aggregate or matched components.

children.label: Asset consumption components
children.classification_note: Depreciation, intangible, nuclear-fuel and residual D&A can be contained in broader asset-consumption adjustments.

concepts.name: us-gaap:Depreciation
concepts.review_reason: Depreciation is the tangible-asset portion of broader DD&A or depreciation/amortization/accretion adjustments.

concepts.name: us-gaap:AmortizationOfIntangibleAssets
concepts.review_reason: Intangible amortization may be included in total DD&A or the general amortization adjustment; it does not represent cash purchase of intangible assets.

concepts.name: us-gaap:AmortizationOfNuclearFuelLease
concepts.review_reason: Despite the Lease suffix, the official definition is amortization of nuclear fuel; it can be included in DD&A and is not a nuclear fuel cash purchase.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OtherDepreciationAndAmortization
concepts.review_reason: Other D&A is a residual inside total DD&A and may overlap broader general amortization adjustments.

children.label: Financing and deferred charge amortization
children.classification_note: Combined financing cost/discount amortization overlaps its individual components. General and residual deferred-charge amortization may contain narrower measures.

concepts.name: us-gaap:AmortizationOfFinancingCostsAndDiscounts
concepts.review_reason: Combined financing-cost/discount amortization can include separate financing-cost and debt-discount amortization adjustments.

concepts.name: us-gaap:AmortizationOfFinancingCosts
concepts.review_reason: Financing-cost amortization can be contained in combined financing-cost-and-discount amortization and in broader amortization adjustments.

concepts.name: us-gaap:AmortizationOfDebtDiscountPremium
concepts.review_reason: Debt discount/premium amortization can be included in combined financing-cost-and-discount amortization and affects interest expense without itself being a cash payment.

concepts.name: us-gaap:AdjustmentForAmortization
concepts.review_reason: General amortization adjustment may contain financing, deferred-charge, intangible and nuclear-fuel amortization; avoid summing inclusive and narrower measures.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OtherAmortizationOfDeferredCharges
concepts.review_reason: Other deferred-charge amortization may be included in general amortization or other noncash adjustments; identify exclusions from financing and nuclear fuel amortization.

children.label: Retirement and other accretion
children.classification_note: ARO accretion differs from AccretionExpense, which explicitly excludes ARO; both can be in a broad combined adjustment.

concepts.name: us-gaap:AssetRetirementObligationAccretionExpense
concepts.review_reason: ARO accretion is a noncash retirement-liability expense and can be included in combined depreciation/amortization/accretion; it is not cash settlement.

concepts.name: us-gaap:AccretionExpense
concepts.review_reason: AccretionExpense explicitly excludes ARO under the official definition; keep it distinct from ARO accretion and the broader combined depreciation/amortization/accretion.

children.label: Impairment and credit adjustment views
children.classification_note: Broad asset impairment can contain goodwill, held-for-use and other impairment; credit provision differs from allowance balances and receivable cash movements.

concepts.name: us-gaap:AssetImpairmentCharges
concepts.review_reason: Broad asset impairment can include goodwill, held-for-use and other impairment charges supplied separately; do not add both total and components.

concepts.name: us-gaap:GoodwillImpairmentLoss
concepts.review_reason: Goodwill impairment is included in broad asset impairment and may be included in other noncash adjustments; avoid duplicate addback.

children.label: Impairment of long lived assets held for use

concepts.name: us-gaap:ImpairmentOfLongLivedAssetsHeldForUse
concepts.review_reason: Held-for-use long-lived impairment overlaps broad impairment and possibly the other-asset impairment category; choose matched scope.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OtherAssetImpairmentCharges
concepts.review_reason: Other-asset impairment excludes goodwill and can overlap held-for-use impairment and broad impairment charges.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProvisionForDoubtfulAccounts
concepts.review_reason: Doubtful-account provision is an expense adjustment distinct from receivable movement; verify whether receivable cash changes already incorporate the provision.

children.label: Equity compensation and benefit adjustments
children.classification_note: Combined employee-benefit/share-compensation adjustments can contain separate share compensation and pension expense; cash contributions appear separately and need a matching reconciliation.

children.label: Employee benefits and share based compensation

concepts.name: us-gaap:EmployeeBenefitsAndShareBasedCompensation
concepts.review_reason: Employee benefits and share compensation can contain standalone share compensation and pension expense adjustments; determine included cash versus noncash elements.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensation
concepts.review_reason: Share-based compensation may be included in employee-benefits-and-share-compensation or broader noncash adjustments; it differs from tax withholding cash payments.

children.label: Pension and other postretirement benefit expense

concepts.name: us-gaap:PensionAndOtherPostretirementBenefitExpense
concepts.review_reason: Pension/postretirement expense is an earnings adjustment distinct from cash contributions and obligation movements; reconcile the indirect-method combination.

children.label: Afudc earnings adjustment views
children.classification_note: Equity AFUDC is contained in total AFUDC where reported. The construction-funds capitalization change can include equity and/or borrowed funds. These earnings additions are not three cash receipts or three independent reversals.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PublicUtilitiesAllowanceForFundsUsedDuringConstructionCapitalizedCostOfEquity
concepts.review_reason: Equity AFUDC is an earnings addition for assumed equity return on construction funds and is contained in total AFUDC where reported; reverse it only once in indirect reconciliation.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PublicUtilitiesAllowanceForFundsUsedDuringConstructionAdditions
concepts.review_reason: AFUDC total increases earnings for equity and/or borrowed funds; it can contain equity AFUDC and overlap the capitalized-funds change, so it is not an extra operating receipt.

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInAllowanceForEquityFundsUsedDuringConstruction
concepts.review_reason: The capitalized construction-funds increase/decrease can cover equity and/or borrowed funds despite its name; it overlaps AFUDC earnings additions and is not independent cash receipt.

children.label: Deferred tax and credit adjustment views
children.classification_note: Deferred tax expense, deferred tax balance movement and deferred-tax/credit totals differ in earnings scope. Credits can be contained in broader adjustments; balance changes require non-earnings reconciliation.

children.label: Deferred income taxes and tax credits

concepts.name: us-gaap:DeferredIncomeTaxesAndTaxCredits
concepts.review_reason: Deferred taxes and tax credits can include deferred tax expense, investment tax credit and other tax-credit adjustments supplied separately.

concepts.name: us-gaap:DeferredIncomeTaxExpenseBenefit
concepts.review_reason: Deferred income tax expense can be contained in deferred taxes and tax credits; it is an earnings adjustment, not cash taxes paid.

children.label: Increase decrease in deferred income taxes

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInDeferredIncomeTaxes
concepts.review_reason: Deferred tax balance change can contain OCI, acquisition and other non-earnings effects; reconcile before using it as an alternative to deferred tax expense.

concepts.name: us-gaap:InvestmentTaxCredit
concepts.review_reason: Investment tax credit includes deferred investment credits and can be part of deferred-tax-and-credit adjustments; it is not cash grant proceeds.

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncomeTaxCreditsAndAdjustments
concepts.review_reason: Tax credits/adjustments can include investment tax credits or be embedded in deferred-tax-and-credit adjustments; they do not by themselves establish cash refunds.

children.label: Disposal and debt earnings adjustments
children.classification_note: Broad asset disposition earnings can include narrower PP&E, business, investment and other disposals. Debt extinguishment gain/loss differs from principal and cash fees. Adjust only effects in starting profit.

concepts.name: us-gaap:GainLossOnDispositionOfAssets1
concepts.review_reason: This disposal gain/loss covers broad assets including PP&E, intangibles and equity interests; it can contain narrower asset, business and investment-sale earnings.

children.label: Gain loss on disposition of assets

concepts.name: us-gaap:GainLossOnDispositionOfAssets
concepts.review_reason: This PP&E disposal gain/loss excludes oil/gas and timber property and is narrower than the broad asset-disposition gain/loss concept ending in 1.

children.label: Gain loss on sale of other assets

concepts.name: us-gaap:GainLossOnSaleOfOtherAssets
concepts.review_reason: Other-asset sale gains can be included in broader disposal earnings; they are not the proceeds received from the sale.

children.label: Gain loss on sale of business

concepts.name: us-gaap:GainLossOnSaleOfBusiness
concepts.review_reason: Business-sale gain/loss can be included in broad asset disposal earnings; cash divestiture receipts belong separately in investing activities.

children.label: Gain loss on sale of investments

concepts.name: us-gaap:GainLossOnSaleOfInvestments
concepts.review_reason: Investment-sale gains can be included in broad disposal earnings and differ from realized cash sale receipts.

children.label: Gains losses on extinguishment of debt

concepts.name: us-gaap:GainsLossesOnExtinguishmentOfDebt
concepts.review_reason: Debt extinguishment gain/loss is an earnings reconciliation and differs from debt repayment principal and separately paid extinguishment costs.

children.label: Derivative and investment earnings adjustments
children.classification_note: Net/realized/unrealized, derivative/commodity and investment measurement scopes overlap. Reverse only appropriate noncash or investing/financing earnings effects already in starting profit; OCI-only effects are not adjustments to profit.

children.label: Derivative earnings views
children.classification_note: Fair-value derivative changes and unrealized derivative/commodity measures overlap all-derivative earnings; cash settlement and noncash remeasurement must be reconciled.

concepts.name: us-gaap:UnrealizedGainLossOnDerivatives
concepts.review_reason: Unrealized derivative gain/loss is a subset of broader derivative earnings and can overlap commodity-contract unrealized adjustments.

children.label: Derivative gain loss on derivative net

concepts.name: us-gaap:DerivativeGainLossOnDerivativeNet
concepts.review_reason: Despite its name, this derivative measure is the increase/decrease in fair value recognized in income; it overlaps unrealized derivative adjustments and is not settlement cash.

children.label: Gain loss on derivative instruments net pretax

concepts.name: us-gaap:GainLossOnDerivativeInstrumentsNetPretax
concepts.review_reason: Net pretax derivative earnings can contain cash-settled and unrealized effects; identify only the appropriate earnings-to-cash adjustment and avoid overlap with fair-value measures.

children.label: Unrealized gain loss on derivatives and commodity contracts

concepts.name: us-gaap:UnrealizedGainLossOnDerivativesAndCommodityContracts
concepts.review_reason: Unrealized derivative/commodity gains can include the narrower unrealized derivative adjustment; commodity coverage differs from all derivative earnings.

children.label: Investment earnings views
children.classification_note: FV-NI includes realized and unrealized equity gains. All-investment and marketable-only unrealized measures overlap; earnings destination requires issuer evidence.

concepts.name: us-gaap:UnrealizedGainLossOnInvestments
concepts.review_reason: Unrealized investment earnings can include marketable security and equity FV-NI adjustments; only the noncash portion of amounts already in starting profit is an indirect adjustment.

children.label: Equity FV-NI realized and unrealized gain loss

concepts.name: us-gaap:EquitySecuritiesFvNiGainLoss
concepts.review_reason: Equity FV-NI gains/losses include realized as well as unrealized effects; do not reverse the full amount as a purely noncash adjustment.

concepts.name: us-gaap:MarketableSecuritiesUnrealizedGainLoss
concepts.review_reason: Marketable-security unrealized gain/loss is narrower than all-investment unrealized earnings and may be in OCI rather than starting profit; verify earnings destination.

children.label: Warrant remeasurement
children.classification_note: Warrant fair-value expense is distinct from warrant exercise cash and can be contained in other noncash adjustments.

concepts.name: us-gaap:FairValueAdjustmentOfWarrants
concepts.review_reason: Warrant-liability fair-value adjustment is earnings remeasurement and may be included in broader noncash expense; it is not warrant exercise cash.

children.label: Equity method return and earnings
children.classification_note: Equity-method income net of distributions already reflects operating return-on-investment distributions. Return of capital is investing; these operating views must not double count the same cash distributions.

children.label: Equity method income net of distributions

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncomeLossFromEquityMethodInvestmentsNetOfDividendsOrDistributions
concepts.review_reason: Equity-method income net of distributions already incorporates the distributions supplied as operating cash return; do not subtract income and add the same distributions again.

children.label: Equity method investment dividends or distributions

concepts.name: us-gaap:EquityMethodInvestmentDividendsOrDistributions
concepts.review_reason: Equity-method dividends/distributions represent operating return on investment under the official definition; distinguish investing return of capital and earnings already net of distributions.

children.label: Operating capital adjustment views
children.classification_note: Total operating capital and residual operating-capital measures can contain all narrower movements. Group hierarchy is organizational, not a calculation.

children.label: Operating capital aggregate alternatives
children.classification_note: Total operating capital, other operating capital, current residual net and noncurrent residual net can overlap the separate balances supplied below.

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInOperatingCapital
concepts.review_reason: Total operating capital change can contain every narrower working-capital movement; use aggregate or matched components.

children.label: Increase decrease in other operating capital net

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInOtherOperatingCapitalNet
concepts.review_reason: Other operating capital net is a residual that can contain narrower other asset/liability changes; confirm exclusions from total operating capital.

children.label: Increase decrease in other current assets and liabilities net

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInOtherCurrentAssetsAndLiabilitiesNet
concepts.review_reason: Net other current asset/liability movement can contain separate other current assets and liabilities and be included in other operating capital.

children.label: Increase decrease in other noncurrent assets and liabilities net

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInOtherNoncurrentAssetsAndLiabilitiesNet
concepts.review_reason: Net other noncurrent asset/liability movement can contain both separate noncurrent residual asset and liability movements.

children.label: Receivable movement views
children.classification_note: Total, accounts-plus-other, accounts and other receivables overlap. Provision adjustments and cash collections require matched gross/net scope.

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInReceivables
concepts.review_reason: Total receivable movement can include accounts, other and tax receivable movements supplied separately; do not add contained categories.

children.label: Increase decrease in accounts and other receivables

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInAccountsAndOtherReceivables
concepts.review_reason: Accounts-and-other receivable changes contain narrower trade and other receivable changes and can be included in total receivables.

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInAccountsReceivable
concepts.review_reason: Accounts-receivable movement may be contained in total receivables or accounts-and-other receivables; do not add these overlapping scopes.

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInOtherReceivables
concepts.review_reason: Other receivables can be included in accounts-plus-other or total receivable changes; match residual exclusions.

children.label: Inventory movement views
children.classification_note: Total inventories can include fuel and materials/supplies movements; commodity and supplies categories are not automatically disjoint.

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInInventories
concepts.review_reason: Inventory movement can contain fuel and materials/supplies movements reported separately; use a consistent inventory population.

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInFuelInventories
concepts.review_reason: Fuel inventory movement can be included in total inventory changes and may overlap fuel reported within materials/supplies.

children.label: Increase decrease in materials and supplies

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInMaterialsAndSupplies
concepts.review_reason: Materials/supplies movement can be contained in total inventories and potentially fuel inventory; establish exclusions before aggregation.

children.label: Prepaid and other asset movement views
children.classification_note: Combined prepaid/deferred/other assets can contain prepayments and current/noncurrent residuals; changes in noncurrent assets are not automatically investing cash.

children.label: Increase decrease in prepaid deferred expense and other assets

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInPrepaidDeferredExpenseAndOtherAssets
concepts.review_reason: Combined prepaid/deferred/other-asset change can contain separate prepaid, deferred fuel and other asset movements; establish issuer exclusions.

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInPrepaidExpense
concepts.review_reason: Prepaid expense movement may be included in the combined prepaid/deferred/other-asset movement and can contain prepaid tax changes.

children.label: Increase decrease in other operating assets

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInOtherOperatingAssets
concepts.review_reason: Other operating assets can include current and noncurrent residual assets and prepayments supplied separately; identify exclusions.

children.label: Increase decrease in other current assets

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInOtherCurrentAssets
concepts.review_reason: Other current assets may be part of other operating assets or net current asset/liability changes; confirm issuer residual coverage.

children.label: Increase decrease in other noncurrent assets

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInOtherNoncurrentAssets
concepts.review_reason: Other noncurrent asset changes can be included in broader other operating assets or net noncurrent asset/liability movements.

children.label: Payable and accrual movement views
children.classification_note: Combined payables/accrual movement can contain standalone accounts, trade, other accruals and interest payable; current related-party operating treatment requires transaction-purpose evidence.

children.label: Increase decrease in accounts payable and accrued liabilities

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInAccountsPayableAndAccruedLiabilities
concepts.review_reason: Combined accounts-payable/accrual changes contain narrower payable, trade payable and accrued-liability movements; select aggregate or reconciled components.

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInAccountsPayable
concepts.review_reason: Accounts-payable changes can include trade accounts payable and be contained in combined payables/accrual movements.

children.label: Increase decrease in accounts payable trade

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInAccountsPayableTrade
concepts.review_reason: Trade payable movement is narrower than total accounts payable and can be included in combined payable/accrual movements.

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInAccruedLiabilities
concepts.review_reason: Accrued-liability changes can contain interest, taxes and other accruals and be included in combined payable/accrual movements.

children.label: Increase decrease in other accounts payable and accrued liabilities

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInOtherAccountsPayableAndAccruedLiabilities
concepts.review_reason: Other payables/accrual movement can be contained in all payables/accrual changes and overlap separate other current liability changes.

children.label: Increase decrease in interest payable net

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInInterestPayableNet
concepts.review_reason: Interest-payable movement can be included in accrued-liability changes and reconciles interest expense to paid interest; do not duplicate the entire paid-interest amount.

children.label: Increase decrease in due to related parties current

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInDueToRelatedPartiesCurrent
concepts.review_reason: Amounts due to related parties can be operating settlements or financing cash-pool balances; confirm issuer transaction purpose before operating classification.

children.label: Tax related operating movements
children.classification_note: Broad tax changes can contain income-tax receivables, current income tax accruals, other tax accruals and prepaid tax movements; do not add aggregates to components.

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInIncomeTaxes
concepts.review_reason: Income tax movement can combine receivable and payable balances and can overlap separate income-tax receivable and accrued-tax movements.

children.label: Increase decrease in accrued income taxes payable

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInAccruedIncomeTaxesPayable
concepts.review_reason: Accrued income tax payable changes are narrower than all-tax payable movements and may be included in the broader income-tax change.

children.label: Increase decrease in accrued taxes payable

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInAccruedTaxesPayable
concepts.review_reason: All accrued tax payable changes can include income tax and non-income tax changes; do not add the income-only movement again.

children.label: Increase decrease in income taxes receivable

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInIncomeTaxesReceivable
concepts.review_reason: Income-tax receivable movement can be included in broad income-tax or total receivable changes; reconcile scope before combining.

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInPrepaidTaxes
concepts.review_reason: Prepaid tax movement can be included in prepaid expense and broader income-tax movements; avoid duplicate cash reconciliation.

children.label: Regulatory and deferred fuel movements
children.classification_note: Combined regulatory assets/liabilities can contain regulatory liability, other regulatory asset and deferred fuel movements; deferred investment tax-credit effects may overlap tax adjustments.

children.label: Increase decrease in regulatory assets and liabilities

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInRegulatoryAssetsAndLiabilities
concepts.review_reason: Combined regulatory asset/liability movement can include separate regulatory liabilities, other regulatory assets and deferred fuel; do not sum the combined and component views.

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInRegulatoryLiabilities
concepts.review_reason: Regulatory liability movement is a component of the combined regulatory asset/liability change and may include deferred investment tax credit effects.

children.label: Increase decrease in other regulatory assets

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInOtherRegulatoryAssets
concepts.review_reason: Other regulatory asset changes can contain recoverable cost deferrals and be included in the combined regulatory asset/liability change.

children.label: Increase decrease in deferred fuel costs

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInDeferredFuelCosts
concepts.review_reason: Deferred fuel cost movement may be included in current regulatory asset changes and the combined regulatory asset/liability movement.

children.label: Customer and residual liability movements
children.classification_note: Customer-contract liabilities can be included in deferred revenue, which can be within other operating liabilities. Current/noncurrent residual changes can be components of broader balances.

children.label: Increase decrease in contract with customer liability

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInContractWithCustomerLiability
concepts.review_reason: Customer-contract liability movement may be included in deferred revenue or other operating liability changes; distinguish the conditional revenue-accounting scope.

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInDeferredRevenue
concepts.review_reason: Deferred revenue movement can contain customer-contract liabilities and be included in other operating liability changes.

children.label: Increase decrease in other operating liabilities

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInOtherOperatingLiabilities
concepts.review_reason: Other operating liabilities can contain current/noncurrent residual liabilities, deferred revenue and other narrower movements; establish exclusions.

children.label: Increase decrease in other current liabilities

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInOtherCurrentLiabilities
concepts.review_reason: Other current liability changes may be part of other operating liabilities and net current asset/liability movement.

children.label: Increase decrease in other noncurrent liabilities

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInOtherNoncurrentLiabilities
concepts.review_reason: Other noncurrent liability changes can be included in broader other operating liabilities or net noncurrent asset/liability movement.

children.label: Benefit obligation and contribution views
children.classification_note: Benefit obligation movement can contain noncash expense/remeasurement and cash contributions. Combined pension/postretirement contributions contain pension-only cash payments; reconcile with benefit expense once.

children.label: Increase decrease in pension and postretirement obligations

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInPensionAndPostretirementObligations
concepts.review_reason: Pension/postretirement obligation movement can contain expense, contributions and noncash remeasurement; reconcile the cash-flow adjustment rather than treating the full balance change as cash.

children.label: Pension and other postretirement benefit contributions

concepts.name: us-gaap:PensionAndOtherPostretirementBenefitContributions
concepts.review_reason: Combined pension/postretirement cash contributions include narrower pension contributions and differ from benefit expense and obligation changes.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PensionContributions
concepts.review_reason: Pension-only contributions are included in combined pension/postretirement contributions where reported.

children.label: Lease reconciliation views
children.classification_note: Operating lease expense, ROU amortization, liability changes and cash lease payments are alternative parts of an indirect reconciliation, not four additive deductions.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OperatingLeaseExpense
concepts.review_reason: Operating lease expense may already be represented by ROU amortization and lease-liability changes; it is not interchangeable with actual lease cash payments.

children.label: Operating lease right of use asset amortization expense

concepts.name: us-gaap:OperatingLeaseRightOfUseAssetAmortizationExpense
concepts.review_reason: Operating ROU amortization is a component of single lease cost and can be offset by liability changes in indirect reconciliation; do not add full lease expense again.

children.label: Increase decrease in operating lease liability

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInOperatingLeaseLiability
concepts.review_reason: Operating lease-liability movement can contain noncash lease additions or modifications; use a reconciled indirect adjustment with lease cost and ROU amortization.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OperatingLeasePayments
concepts.review_reason: Operating lease payments can already be captured by lease expense, ROU amortization and lease-liability movements in an indirect reconciliation; do not add a second full payment adjustment.

children.label: Derivative and collateral movement candidates
children.classification_note: Derivative balance changes can contain noncash fair values. Deposits and collateral need issuer transaction-purpose, cash population and netting evidence before operating treatment.

children.label: Increase decrease in derivative assets and liabilities

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInDerivativeAssetsAndLiabilities
concepts.review_reason: Derivative asset/liability movement can contain fair-value remeasurement and collateral effects as well as settlements; do not assume the entire balance movement is cash.

children.label: Increase decrease in deposit other assets

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInDepositOtherAssets
concepts.review_reason: Other deposit asset movement requires issuer evidence of operating use versus investing/restricted-cash transfer; do not classify solely by the deposit name.

children.label: Increase decrease in margin deposits outstanding

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInMarginDepositsOutstanding
concepts.review_reason: Margin deposit changes may be operating collateral flows or transfers within cash restrictions; determine instrument purpose and cash population.

children.label: Increase decrease cash collateral from counterparties

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseCashCollateralFromCounterparties
concepts.review_reason: Cash collateral from counterparties can include cash held or posted with third parties for derivatives; direction, operating classification and restricted-cash population require issuer reconciliation.

children.label: Retirement cash settlements
children.classification_note: Actual ARO cash settlement is generally operating under the official definition. Reconcile inclusion in reported operating adjustments and distinguish all-cause liability change and plant removal candidates.

children.label: Asset retirement obligation cash paid to settle

concepts.name: us-gaap:AssetRetirementObligationCashPaidToSettle
concepts.review_reason: ARO cash settlement is generally operating under the official definition; confirm issuer inclusion in other operating cash adjustments and do not substitute total ARO balance movement.

children.label: Residual operating adjustments
children.classification_note: Net noncash income/expense can contain expense-only residuals and specific adjustments. Other operating cash is a reported residual, not a newly calculated plug.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OtherNoncashIncomeExpense
concepts.review_reason: Net other noncash income/expense may include expense-only residuals and specific noncash adjustments; do not add overlapping residual views.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OtherNoncashExpense
concepts.review_reason: Expense-only other noncash adjustments can be contained in net other noncash income/expense; do not add both residual views.

children.label: Other operating activities cash flow statement
Productive asset cash purchase views
children.classification_note: All investing-asset, productive-asset, PP&E, intangible and other productive purchases overlap. Select a reported aggregate or matched components; unpaid capex and noncash leases stay supplementary.

children.label: Payments to acquire assets investing activities

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireAssetsInvestingActivities
concepts.review_reason: All investing asset purchases can contain PP&E, intangibles and other productive assets; no extra asset-purchase outflow is inferred alongside its components.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireProductiveAssets
concepts.review_reason: Productive-asset cash purchases can contain PP&E, nuclear fuel or other productive assets; select a consistent reported aggregate or components.

children.label: Payments to acquire property plant and equipment

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquirePropertyPlantAndEquipment
concepts.review_reason: PP&E cash acquisition may be contained in productive-asset or all-investing-asset purchases; nuclear fuel and capitalized interest require matched inclusion.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireIntangibleAssets
concepts.review_reason: Intangible cash purchases can be contained in productive-asset or all-investing-asset purchases; do not treat amortization as a cash purchase.

children.label: Payments to acquire other productive assets

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireOtherProductiveAssets
concepts.review_reason: Other productive-asset purchases can be contained in productive-asset or broad investing-asset purchase totals.

children.label: Nuclear fuel cash views
children.classification_note: Gross nuclear fuel purchases and net nuclear fuel payments/proceeds are alternative scopes. Verify issuer investing classification and inclusion in reported PP&E/productive cash purchases.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsForNuclearFuel
concepts.review_reason: Nuclear fuel cash purchases can be included in PP&E/productive-asset purchases or the net nuclear-fuel cash measure; verify inclusion before treating them as separate capex.

children.label: Payments for proceeds from nuclear fuel

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsForProceedsFromNuclearFuel
concepts.review_reason: Net nuclear fuel cash payments/proceeds can include gross nuclear fuel purchases and recovery receipts; verify investing section and PP&E inclusion before aggregation.

children.label: Productive asset disposal cash views
children.classification_note: Broad investing-asset sales can contain productive, PP&E, other productive and intangible receipts. No gain/loss amount is cash proceeds.

children.label: Proceeds from sales of assets investing activities

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromSalesOfAssetsInvestingActivities
concepts.review_reason: Broad investing-asset sale proceeds can contain PP&E, intangibles, productive assets and other dispositions; avoid adding both aggregate and components.

children.label: Proceeds from sale of productive assets

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfProductiveAssets
concepts.review_reason: Productive-asset sale proceeds can include PP&E, intangible and other productive asset disposals; do not combine aggregate and contained sales.

children.label: Proceeds from sale of property plant and equipment
Proceeds from sale of other productive assets

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfOtherProductiveAssets
concepts.review_reason: Other productive-asset sale receipts can be included in productive-asset or broad investing-asset sale totals.

children.label: Proceeds from sale of intangible assets

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfIntangibleAssets
concepts.review_reason: Intangible sale receipts can be included in productive-asset and broad investing-asset sale proceeds.

children.label: Business acquisition and divestiture cash
children.classification_note: Acquisition payments net of cash already incorporate acquired cash. Business divestitures and subsidiary/affiliate sales can overlap; control-retaining equity transactions belong in financing.

children.label: Payments to acquire businesses net of cash acquired

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireBusinessesNetOfCashAcquired
concepts.review_reason: Business acquisition payments are net of acquired cash, so acquired cash must not be added again without matching a gross acquisition presentation.

concepts.name: us-gaap:CashAcquiredFromAcquisition
concepts.review_reason: Acquired cash is already deducted from acquisition payments reported net of cash acquired; it is not an extra inflow to add to that net amount.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromDivestitureOfBusinesses
concepts.review_reason: Business divestiture receipts can overlap sales of subsidiary/affiliate interests or other investing asset-sale proceeds; match deconsolidation and cash scope.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromDivestitureOfInterestInSubsidiariesAndAffiliates
concepts.review_reason: Subsidiary/affiliate divestiture receipts involve deconsolidation or sale of an affiliate and differ from ownership transactions retaining control; they can overlap business divestiture totals.

children.label: Investment cash purchase views
children.classification_note: Total investment purchases can include other, short-term, marketable, AFS debt, equity-method and decommissioning portfolios. Type, maturity and purpose views are not additive.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireInvestments
concepts.review_reason: Total investment purchases can include short-term, marketable, AFS debt, equity-method and decommissioning fund investments; reconcile portfolio inclusion.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireOtherInvestments
concepts.review_reason: Other investment purchases can be a residual in total investment acquisitions and may contain decommissioning or other specified portfolios.

children.label: Payments to acquire short term investments

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireShortTermInvestments
concepts.review_reason: Short-term investment purchases can include marketable and AFS debt purchases; maturity and security-type views overlap.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireMarketableSecurities
concepts.review_reason: Marketable-security purchases can include AFS debt and short-term investments and may already be included in total investment acquisitions.

children.label: Payments to acquire available for sale securities debt

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireAvailableForSaleSecuritiesDebt
concepts.review_reason: AFS debt purchases are a security-type subset of total or marketable investment purchases and can overlap decommissioning fund portfolios.

children.label: Payments to acquire equity method investments

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireEquityMethodInvestments
concepts.review_reason: Equity-method investment purchases can be contained in total investment acquisitions; distinguish funding from capital returns and distributions.

children.label: Investment cash receipt views
children.classification_note: Total sale/maturity/collection receipts can include marketable securities, AFS debt, other investments, loan collections and trust sales. Return of capital differs from operating equity distributions.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleMaturityAndCollectionsOfInvestments
concepts.review_reason: Investment sale/maturity/collection proceeds can include marketable securities, other investments, trust assets and loan collections; select total or matched components.

children.label: Proceeds from sale and maturity of marketable securities

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleAndMaturityOfMarketableSecurities
concepts.review_reason: Marketable-security sale/maturity receipts can contain AFS debt sales and be included in all-investment receipts; reconcile portfolio scope.

children.label: Proceeds from sale of available for sale securities debt

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfAvailableForSaleSecuritiesDebt
concepts.review_reason: AFS debt sale receipts can be included in marketable and all-investment sale/maturity receipts, including trust investment activity.

children.label: Proceeds from sale and maturity of other investments

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleAndMaturityOfOtherInvestments
concepts.review_reason: Other investment sale/maturity proceeds can be a residual in total investment receipts and may contain decommissioning trust sales.

children.label: Equity method distributions return of capital

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromEquityMethodInvestmentDividendsOrDistributionsReturnOfCapital
concepts.review_reason: Equity-method return of capital is investing cash, unlike operating return on investment distributions; issuer distribution classification controls.

children.label: Proceeds from collection of notes receivable

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromCollectionOfNotesReceivable
concepts.review_reason: Note collections are investing recovery of loan principal and can be included in broader investment sale/maturity/collection receipts; interest receipts are a different flow.

children.label: Net investment cash alternative
children.classification_note: Net investment payments/proceeds is an alternative to matched gross acquisitions and sales, not another receipt or payment.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsForProceedsFromInvestments
concepts.review_reason: Net investment payments/proceeds overlap gross purchase and sale/maturity cash measures; use one presentation for matched portfolios.

children.label: Decommissioning fund investment cash
children.classification_note: Trust investment purchases and asset-sale receipts can be included in investment aggregates; funding investment activity differs from physical plant decommissioning cash.

children.label: Payments to invest in decommissioning fund

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsToInvestInDecommissioningFund
concepts.review_reason: Decommissioning fund purchases can be included in total or marketable investment purchases; they fund a trust and are not physical decommissioning expenditures.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromDecommissioningFund
concepts.review_reason: Decommissioning fund receipts are sale proceeds of trust investments and can already be included in investment-sale totals; they are not necessarily direct ARO funding withdrawals.

children.label: Construction related investing receipts
children.classification_note: Construction aid and other-funds AFUDC investing inflows are explicitly investing concepts. Neither is automatically share capital or an additional equity AFUDC reversal.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromContributionInAidOfConstruction
concepts.review_reason: Construction-aid contributions are explicitly investing cash receipts under the official definition, not automatically equity financing despite the word contribution.

concepts.name: us-gaap:AllowanceForFundsUsedDuringConstructionInvestingActivities
concepts.review_reason: The official definition explicitly identifies investing cash inflow from other-funds AFUDC; it is distinct from the equity AFUDC noncash earnings adjustment.

children.label: Affiliate loan advances
children.classification_note: Advances to affiliates are separate from equity funding and operating related-party settlement; confirm investing loan purpose.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsForAdvanceToAffiliate
concepts.review_reason: Advances to affiliates are investing loans under this candidate classification; confirm no cash-pool or operating settlement treatment and distinguish equity contributions.

children.label: Insurance and other investing cash
children.classification_note: Insurance settlements here are explicitly investing; other investing net cash can contain smaller residual investing flows.

children.label: Proceeds from insurance settlement investing activities
Payments for proceeds from other investing activities
Financing scope views
children.classification_note: Continuing and discontinued financing cash are scope views within total financing where reported; do not add the total again.

children.label: Gross debt issuance views
children.classification_note: Total proceeds can include long/short-term, note, convertible, senior and secured instruments. Instrument type, maturity, collateral and seniority axes overlap.

children.label: Debt issuance aggregates
children.classification_note: Total debt issuance can contain long-term borrowing receipts; neither should be combined with contained instrument proceeds.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromIssuanceOfDebt
concepts.review_reason: Total debt issuance can contain long-term, short-term, note, secured and convertible proceeds supplied separately; do not add instrument/maturity views to it.

children.label: Proceeds from issuance of long term debt
Debt issuance instrument views
children.classification_note: Other long-term, senior long-term, secured, convertible and note proceeds may overlap each other and maturity totals.

children.label: Proceeds from issuance of other long term debt

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromIssuanceOfOtherLongTermDebt
concepts.review_reason: Other long-term debt proceeds are a residual in long-term debt issuance and can overlap security/seniority classes.

children.label: Proceeds from issuance of senior long term debt

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromIssuanceOfSeniorLongTermDebt
concepts.review_reason: Senior long-term borrowing proceeds are a seniority subset of long-term debt issuance and can include secured or other debt measures.

children.label: Proceeds from issuance of secured debt

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromIssuanceOfSecuredDebt
concepts.review_reason: Secured borrowing receipts are a collateral classification that can overlap long-term or short-term debt issuance; do not add them to inclusive maturity totals.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromConvertibleDebt
concepts.review_reason: Convertible borrowing proceeds can be included in total and long-term debt issuance; conversion itself is a separate noncash event.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromNotesPayable
concepts.review_reason: Note borrowing receipts can be included in debt issuance and maturity-specific proceeds; instrument and maturity axes overlap.

children.label: Short term borrowing receipts
children.classification_note: Other short-term and above-three-month proceeds can be in total short-term borrowings; net short-term presentations remain separate.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromShortTermDebt
concepts.review_reason: Short-term debt issuance overlaps credit lines, commercial paper and other short-term borrowing details and differs from a net issue/repayment measure.

children.label: Proceeds from other short term debt

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromOtherShortTermDebt
concepts.review_reason: Other short-term borrowing proceeds are a residual in short-term debt receipts and may overlap net short-term debt movement.

children.label: Short term borrowings above three months

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromShortTermDebtMaturingInMoreThanThreeMonths
concepts.review_reason: Short-term debt receipts with maturity above three months are a subset of total short-term borrowing and distinct from the net three-month-or-less measure.

children.label: Credit line receipts
children.classification_note: Long-term lines are a subset of unsplit line receipts and can be included in long-term debt proceeds.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromLinesOfCredit
concepts.review_reason: Drawn credit-line receipts can be included in debt issuance and short/long-term debt totals; maturity is not established by the credit-line name.

children.label: Proceeds from long term lines of credit

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromLongTermLinesOfCredit
concepts.review_reason: Long-term credit-line proceeds can be contained in unsplit line receipts and long-term debt issuance.

children.label: Gross debt repayment views
children.classification_note: Broad long-term debt/capital securities and long-term repayments overlap. Security, note, line and residual views can be contained in maturity totals.

children.label: Long term repayment views
children.classification_note: Long-term debt/capital securities can contain long-term debt repayments; other long-term repayment is a residual subset.

children.label: Repayments of long term debt and capital securities

concepts.name: us-gaap:RepaymentsOfLongTermDebtAndCapitalSecurities
concepts.review_reason: Repayments of long-term debt and capital securities can contain standalone long-term debt repayments; reconcile instrument coverage.

children.label: Repayments of other long term debt

concepts.name: us-gaap:RepaymentsOfOtherLongTermDebt
concepts.review_reason: Other long-term debt repayment is a residual in long-term repayment totals and may overlap instrument-type or security-based repayment views.

children.label: Instrument and credit repayments
children.classification_note: Unsecured repayment and note/line settlement may already be included in maturity totals; long-term lines are narrower than all-line repayments.

concepts.name: us-gaap:RepaymentsOfUnsecuredDebt
concepts.review_reason: Unsecured debt repayments are a collateral classification overlapping debt maturity repayment totals; do not combine orthogonal instrument and maturity views.

concepts.name: us-gaap:RepaymentsOfLinesOfCredit
concepts.review_reason: Credit-line repayments may already be included in short/long-term debt repayment totals; the unsplit concept does not establish maturity.

children.label: Repayments of long term lines of credit

concepts.name: us-gaap:RepaymentsOfLongTermLinesOfCredit
concepts.review_reason: Long-term credit-line repayments can be contained in unsplit line repayments and long-term debt repayments.

children.label: Short term repayment views
children.classification_note: Other short-term repayments are part of the broader short-term repayment amount.

concepts.name: us-gaap:RepaymentsOfShortTermDebt
concepts.review_reason: Short-term repayments can contain other short-term repayments and credit-line settlements; use gross receipts/payments or matched net movement, not both.

children.label: Repayments of other short term debt

concepts.name: us-gaap:RepaymentsOfOtherShortTermDebt
concepts.review_reason: Other short-term debt repayments can be contained in all short-term debt repayments and overlap net borrowing movements.

children.label: Net debt movement alternatives
children.classification_note: Net borrowing presentations overlap gross receipts/payments. Commercial-paper and three-month-or-less net movements can be contained in all short-term debt net movement.

children.label: Proceeds from repayments of short term debt
Proceeds from repayments of commercial paper

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfCommercialPaper
concepts.review_reason: Net commercial-paper proceeds/repayments can be contained in net short-term debt movement; do not combine that net measure with gross components.

children.label: Net short term debt three months or less

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfShortTermDebtMaturingInThreeMonthsOrLess
concepts.review_reason: Net borrowing movement for maturities of three months or less is narrower than all short-term debt net movement and differs from gross issuance/repayment.

children.label: Proceeds from repayments of other debt

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfOtherDebt
concepts.review_reason: Other debt net proceeds/repayments can contain gross other-debt receipts/repayments supplied separately; preserve net versus gross presentation.

children.label: Related party debt cash
children.classification_note: Related-party gross receipts and repayments overlap the net related-party debt movement and can already be contained in maturity-based debt totals; equity contributions differ.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromRelatedPartyDebt
concepts.review_reason: Related-party borrowing proceeds can be included in debt issuance totals and in net related-party debt proceeds/repayments.

concepts.name: us-gaap:RepaymentsOfRelatedPartyDebt
concepts.review_reason: Related-party debt repayments overlap debt maturity aggregates; retain separate gross/net related-party presentations without combining them.

children.label: Proceeds from repayments of related party debt

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfRelatedPartyDebt
concepts.review_reason: Related-party debt net proceeds/repayments overlap separate gross related-party borrowings and repayments.

children.label: Finance lease principal
children.classification_note: Finance lease principal is financing cash and differs from noncash initial ROU asset acquisition; avoid duplication if broader debt repayment includes lease principal.

children.label: Equity cash issuance views
children.classification_note: Common stock, incentive-plan, option, warrant, IPO and treasury resale proceeds can overlap. Stock transaction proceeds net of costs differ from gross issuance proceeds.

children.label: Proceeds from issuance of common stock

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromIssuanceOfSharesUnderIncentiveAndShareBasedCompensationPlansIncludingStockOptions
concepts.review_reason: Share-incentive issuance cash includes stock option exercises and can be part of total common stock proceeds; avoid duplicate equity inflows.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromWarrantExercises
concepts.review_reason: Warrant exercise cash may be included in common stock issuance proceeds and is distinct from noncash warrant fair-value earnings.

children.label: Proceeds from issuance initial public offering

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromIssuanceInitialPublicOffering
concepts.review_reason: IPO cash proceeds can be included in common stock issuance and may have different issuance-cost netting; identify gross/net basis.

children.label: Proceeds from sale of treasury stock

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfTreasuryStock
concepts.review_reason: Treasury-stock resale cash can be included in common stock proceeds or plan issuance receipts; it is not a reduction of repurchase cash for a different period.

children.label: Stock transaction cash net of issuance costs

concepts.name: us-gaap:SaleOfStockConsiderationReceivedOnTransaction
concepts.review_reason: Stock transaction cash is after issuance costs and can overlap gross common-share proceeds and stock issuance cost payments; select one consistent basis.

children.label: Share repurchases and withholding
children.classification_note: Common/preferred repurchases and award tax-withholding payments are distinct financing cash flows; reconcile issuer equity settlement totals.

children.label: Payments for repurchase of common stock
Payments for repurchase of preferred stock and preference stock
Payments related to tax withholding for share based compensation

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsRelatedToTaxWithholdingForShareBasedCompensation
concepts.review_reason: Tax-withholding payments for share awards are financing cash outflows and may be included in broader equity settlement cash; they are not the noncash compensation expense.

children.label: Noncontrolling and affiliate equity cash
children.classification_note: NCI ownership inflows/outflows exclude NCI dividends on the outflow measure. Additional interests retaining control can overlap NCI payments. Affiliate equity contributions differ from related-party debt.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromMinorityShareholders
concepts.review_reason: Cash from noncontrolling shareholders is an ownership financing inflow and can overlap affiliate contributions; it differs from proceeds from deconsolidating a subsidiary.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsToMinorityShareholders
concepts.review_reason: Payments to noncontrolling shareholders exclude NCI dividends and can contain purchases of additional subsidiary interests; avoid adding the acquisition detail twice.

children.label: Payments to acquire additional interest in subsidiaries

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireAdditionalInterestInSubsidiaries
concepts.review_reason: Additional subsidiary-interest purchases are financing when control is retained and may be included in payments to NCI; acquisitions obtaining control belong in business investing purchases.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromContributionsFromAffiliates
concepts.review_reason: Affiliate capital contributions are equity funding rather than affiliate debt and can overlap NCI cash contributions for consolidated subsidiaries.

children.label: Cash dividend views
children.classification_note: All dividends may contain ordinary/common, preferred and NCI dividends; common and ordinary dividends can overlap. These are cash payments, not declared dividends or EPS adjustments.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsOfDividends
concepts.review_reason: All dividends paid can contain common, preferred and noncontrolling dividends depending on issuer scope; do not add these to an inclusive total.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsOfOrdinaryDividends
concepts.review_reason: Ordinary dividends can overlap common stock dividends and all dividends paid; identify share-class coverage before aggregation.

children.label: Payments of dividends preferred stock and preference stock

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsOfDividendsMinorityInterest
concepts.review_reason: NCI dividends are distributions distinct from ownership-reduction payments to NCI and may already be in total dividends.

children.label: Financing transaction cost views
children.classification_note: Broad financing costs may contain debt issuance and extinguishment fees. Stock costs can already be netted in reported stock proceeds; no duplicate gross/net adjustment.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsOfFinancingCosts
concepts.review_reason: Financing costs can include debt issuance costs; confirm whether proceeds have already been reported net of costs.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsOfDebtIssuanceCosts
concepts.review_reason: Debt issuance costs can be included in broader financing costs or netted against issuance proceeds; do not count both presentations.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsOfDebtExtinguishmentCosts
concepts.review_reason: Debt extinguishment costs paid differ from principal repayment and accounting gain/loss; reconcile inclusion in financing costs or debt proceeds netting.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsOfStockIssuanceCosts
concepts.review_reason: Stock issuance costs may already be deducted from stock transaction proceeds reported net of issuance costs.

children.label: Other financing cash
children.classification_note: Reported residual other financing proceeds/payments can contain other disclosed financing items; it is not a plug calculated from missing facts.

children.label: Proceeds from payments for other financing activities

nodes.label: Cash reconciliation
nodes.classification_note: Cash populations must match across balances, period changes and FX effects. Instant balances can be reported for beginning/end contexts; no duplicated beginning/end concept or automatic reconciliation is manufactured.

children.label: Cash balance scope views
children.classification_note: Cash including disposal groups/discontinued operations has broader scope; choose the balance matching the period-change and cash-flow population.

children.label: Cash balance including disposals and discontinued

concepts.name: us-gaap:CashCashEquivalentsRestrictedCashAndRestrictedCashEquivalentsIncludingDisposalGroupAndDiscontinuedOperations
concepts.review_reason: This instant cash balance includes disposal groups/discontinued operations, unlike a cash population that excludes those balances; use matching cash-flow and exchange-effect scope.

children.label: Cash period change views
children.classification_note: Changes including and excluding FX are alternative reconciliation views; FX is included only once.

children.label: Cash and restricted cash change including FX
Cash and restricted cash change excluding FX
Exchange effect scope views
children.classification_note: The broader FX effect includes disposal groups/discontinued operations; select scope matching the cash balance rather than adding both FX measures.

children.label: Exchange effect on cash and restricted cash
Exchange effect including disposals and discontinued

nodes.label: Supplementary disclosures
nodes.classification_note: Supplemental paid interest/taxes, noncash acquisitions and unresolved activity candidates remain outside automatic cash-flow aggregation. Monetary duration does not establish actual cash movement.

children.label: Cash interest and tax disclosures
children.classification_note: Paid interest and taxes can be supplemental amounts already contained in operating cash. Net tax payment differs from gross taxes paid; net interest excludes capitalized interest under its definition.

concepts.name: us-gaap:InterestPaidNet
concepts.review_reason: Net interest paid is operating cash interest excluding capitalized interest under the official definition; it is not an extra payment to add to a matching operating cash total.

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncomeTaxesPaid
concepts.review_reason: Gross income taxes paid differ from net tax payments after refunds; they are alternative supplemental measures.

children.label: Noncash capital and acquisition disclosures
children.classification_note: Unpaid capex, noncash ROU additions, fair value of assets acquired and liabilities assumed are not current cash payments. Acquisition fair values can include cash/noncash consideration and need transaction reconciliation.

children.label: Capital expenditures incurred but not yet paid

concepts.name: us-gaap:CapitalExpendituresIncurredButNotYetPaid
concepts.review_reason: Capital expenditures incurred but unpaid are noncash additions; do not count them as current cash PP&E purchases.

children.label: Noncash equity and conversion disclosures
children.classification_note: Stock issued at fair value, debt converted and stock/warrants for services are noncash activity; none is cash stock proceeds or principal repayment.

children.label: Stock and warrants for services or claims

concepts.name: us-gaap:IssuanceOfStockAndWarrantsForServicesOrClaims
concepts.review_reason: Stock/warrants for services or claims are noncash fair-value compensation, not stock issuance cash proceeds or warrant exercise receipts.

children.label: Capitalized interest disclosure
children.classification_note: Amount capitalized is not itself a cash payment fact and may overlap debt AFUDC or cash PP&E expenditures; reconcile source cash context.

concepts.name: us-gaap:InterestCostsCapitalized
concepts.review_reason: Capitalized interest is the amount capitalized, not proof of cash interest paid in the period; retain outside direct cash payments pending reconciliation.

children.label: Aro balance movement disclosure
children.classification_note: Total ARO carrying change can include additions, estimates, accretion, settlements and disposals; actual settlement cash is separately mapped in operating.

children.label: Increase decrease in asset retirement obligations

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInAssetRetirementObligations
concepts.review_reason: ARO carrying-amount change can contain incurred obligations, revisions, accretion, settlements and disposals; it is not a cash settlement amount.

children.label: Unresolved plant removal cash
children.classification_note: Plant disposal/removal net cash can overlap operating ARO settlements or investing asset disposal; issuer evidence is needed before selecting section.

children.label: Payments for proceeds from removal costs

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsForProceedsFromRemovalCosts
concepts.review_reason: Net plant removal cash can include demolition, abandonment or sale effects and may overlap ARO operating settlements; keep section unresolved until issuer presentation is known.

children.label: Unresolved capital instrument receipts
children.classification_note: Private-placement capital does not specify debt or equity. Partnership-unit sale may be investment disposal or issuer unit financing; resolve transaction role before section placement.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromIssuanceOfPrivatePlacement
concepts.review_reason: Private-placement capital proceeds do not identify debt versus equity under the official definition; retain outside either financing subtype pending issuer evidence.

children.label: Proceeds from sale of interest in partnership unit

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfInterestInPartnershipUnit
concepts.review_reason: Partnership-unit sale proceeds do not establish whether the entity sold an investment or issued its own ownership units; investing versus financing classification requires issuer evidence.
